page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor operating at a baseline frequency of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance configuration does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring reliance on external block storage volumes for persistent data. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, limiting its applicability for heavy parallel computing or deep learning workloads. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio position this instance as a stable resource for predictable workloads. It is designed for general-purpose applications, web serving, microservices, and development environments that require consistent CPU performance without the overhead of specialized hardware.
